title: Web URL Tracking
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D Web Server-based link redirection and UUID obfuscation
HTML source converter for tagging campaign links

historical_commentary.text: The core approach — storing links keyed by UUID in a 4D table, incrementing a counter, and redirecting via a 4D Web Server process — is a generic pattern that still works today and requires no deprecated technology, so it remains functionally valid. That said, this exact home-grown click-tracking approach has been largely superseded in the broader industry by dedicated analytics platforms and URL shorteners with built-in tracking, and a modern 4D implementation would likely expose the redirect/tracking endpoint via 4D's REST/ORDA layer rather than the classic 4D Web Server method-based routing shown here.
related_updates: 4D REST server built on ORDA (introduced v16 R5/17+) as a more standard way to expose tracking/redirect endpoints
Dedicated third-party analytics and URL-shortening services have largely replaced bespoke in-house click trackers industry-wide
